header.title: SharedLayout
header.description: Shared-element morph between collapsed and expanded layout rects (FLIP: translate + scale). Toggle `isExpanded` for a local morph, or share a `layoutId` to morph across different tree locations. `crossfade` (default `true`) fades surface content while the box adjusts.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props, expand the card, and watch the generated code. Expand uses `enter` timing; collapse uses `exit`.
playground.detailBody: Same element, expanded layout. Position and size morph with transform while content updates.

base.title: Base
base.description: With `collapsed` and `expanded`, toggling `isExpanded` morphs the host with FLIP between the tile and the detail panel.

texts.detailBody: Same element, expanded layout. Position and size morph with transform while content updates.

renderProp.title: Render prop
renderProp.description: Instead of `collapsed` / `expanded` slots, pass a function `children` that receives `{ isExpanded }` and branches the content.

timing.title: Expand / collapse timing
timing.description: `duration`, `delay`, and `easing` accept `{ enter, exit }`: `enter` is expand and `exit` is collapse. Here expand lasts `420` ms with `emphasized`; collapse lasts `240` ms with `exit`.

texts.detailBody: Same element, expanded layout. Position and size morph with transform while content updates.

crossfade.title: crossfade
crossfade.description: Side-by-side: left keeps the default fade; right uses `crossfade={false}` so content pops while only transform morphs.

texts.withFadeBody: Surface opacity eases in while the box morphs.
texts.withoutFadeBody: Content swaps immediately; only transform morphs.

grid.title: In a grid
grid.description: Each cell owns a `SharedLayout`. Expanding one morphs only that card in place.

texts.detailBody: Expanded detail for this grid cell. Click again to collapse.

layoutId.title: layoutId
layoutId.description: Same `layoutId` on two hosts in different tree locations. Toggling mode unmounts one and mounts the other — FLIP morphs from the previous rect.

texts.detailBody: Morphed into the stage via layoutId — same visual identity, new tree node.

gallery.title: Gallery → lightbox
gallery.description: Gallery pattern: each thumb uses `layoutId={"photo-{id}"}`. Opening one unmounts the thumb host and mounts a lightbox host with the same id — global FLIP across the tree.

blurbs.alpha: Cool tone tile that expands into a lightbox panel.
blurbs.beta: Warm tone tile — same layoutId family, unique per item.
blurbs.gamma: Neutral tile demonstrating handoff from grid to overlay.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onStart` fires when the morph plays (invert → play) and `onComplete` when it settles. `onSharedLayout` / `outSharedLayout` track the `isExpanded` lifecycle (`enter`, `disabled`, `unmount`).

texts.detailBody: Watch the event list update as the morph runs.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: With `isDisabled` (or `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`) the host snaps to the target layout with no morph.

texts.detailBody: Same element, expanded layout. No interpolation because motion is disabled.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, classes and morph land on the single child. There is no `__surface`, so the `crossfade` fade has no inner wrapper to target.

texts.title: Order #4821
texts.long: Expanded detail: the Card is the morph host. Size follows content and FLIP interpolates the rect.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Pass `utilities.css` helpers via `classNames` to override layout / overflow without Design System CSS. This demo applies `gemst-relative` and `gemst-overflow-hidden` on `root`, `gemst-block` on `surface` / `expanded`, and `gemst-inline-flex` on `collapsed`.

texts.detailBody: Same element, expanded layout. Position and size morph with transform while content updates.

tailwind.detailBody: Tailwind utilities and CSS variables on the host and content.

variant.detailBody: Wrapper with `cva` + `cn` that exports the wrapped SharedLayout.

styled.detailBody: `--gemst-shared-layout-*` variables are overridden from the `card-shell` class.

header.title: SharedLayout API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `SharedLayout`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for local morph, layoutId, and crossfade.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/shared-layout` with its `shared-layout.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (minus children) and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. In that case classes and styles merge with the child's, and if both define the same handler, the child's runs first. The component handles onTransitionEnd internally (to detect the end of transform) and then calls yours.

items.motionOnly: The morph is decorative: do not convey state with motion alone. Expanded / collapsed content must stand on its own (text, aria-expanded on the control, etc.).
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the host snaps to the target rect. The preference is read each render; it is not live-listened.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the morph and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion on the root. Use only when motion is essential.
items.crossfade: The crossfade fade targets __surface. With asChild there is no surface, so content does not fade.
items.layoutId: With layoutId, only one active host per id. When one unmounts and another mounts, the new host morphs from the previous rect. Do not nest two hosts with the same id at once.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a child with the right semantics (Card, article, section): that element is the FLIP host.

items.root: Root (`div`, or the child with `asChild`). `inline-flex`, `transform-origin: top left`.
items.playing: During morph play. Enables the `transform` transition.
items.surfaceCollapsed: Surface in collapsed state (when using `collapsed` / `expanded` slots).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline each render (`0ms` when `isDisabled` or reduced motion). Used by the `transform` transition (and opacity when `crossfade`).

items.duration: Duration of the current phase (expand = `enter`, collapse = `exit`). Default `300ms`.
items.delay: Delay of the current phase. Default `0ms`.
items.easing: Easing of the current phase. Default `emphasized`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables used as CSS defaults.

items.easingEmphasized: Default for `--gemst-shared-layout-easing`. The component writes the resolved curve inline, so redefining the token will not change the animation — use `easing`.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Expanded state, shared identity, and fade.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: In milliseconds. `enter` applies on expand and `exit` on collapse.

items.children: Content when you are not using `collapsed` / `expanded`. Pass a function to branch with `{ isExpanded }`.
items.collapsed: Content for the reduced / summary state. Prefer with `expanded`.
items.expanded: Content for the expanded / detail state. Prefer with `collapsed`.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child. No `__surface`; the `crossfade` fade has no inner wrapper.
items.isExpanded: `true` morphs to the expanded rect; `false` morphs back to collapsed. Default `false`.
items.layoutId: Shared id for FLIP across tree locations. When one host unmounts and another with the same id mounts, the new host morphs from the previous rect.
items.crossfade: Fade surface content while the box morphs. Default `true`. Not useful with `asChild`.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is expand and `exit` is collapse.
items.delay: Wait before starting. Accepts `{ enter, exit }` like `duration`.
items.easing: Token (`standard`, `enter`, `exit`, `emphasized`, `linear`), a CSS timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default `emphasized`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the target layout with no morph.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onStart: Fires when a morph begins (invert → play).
items.onComplete: Fires when a morph settles (transition end, snap, or identity skip).
items.onSharedLayout: Fires when the layout expands (`isExpanded` becomes true).
items.outSharedLayout: Fires when the layout collapses (`isExpanded` becomes false), is disabled, or unmounts.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with the morph transform and `--gemst-shared-layout-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
